title: Preregistered multi-node benchmark on the Linux e-waste fleet
objective: If T003's controls qualify: preregister and run a bounded benchmark measuring PostgreSQL coordination overhead separately from execution and artifact transfer, with throughput, claim latency, retry amplification, storage growth, recovery and correctness; document any bottleneck precisely before proposing a component.
problem: Fabric was proven at pilot scale; Moonshot's scale is unmeasured.
evidence_required: prereg committed before any benchmark data; report vs frozen bounds

acceptance.condition: preregistered report produced (a failed bound is a valid result)

resource_ceiling: MWO-0004 R2 (local, unpaid; <=16 core-hours per item, <=48 per seat per 24 h)
